scope: Stock G3/G4 owner update postconditions and repeated ordering; NOT adapter guards/signoff
postconditions: Every rejected update preserved the entire target and control rows, including a simultaneously submitted valid note change. Native update SQL-constraint failures differ from native insert HTTP 400 failures.

unknownUpdateField.native: Succeeded: ignored the unknown field and applied the valid note change; all other fields unchanged.
unknownUpdateField.reference: Rejected with HTTP 400/PGRST204 and preserved the complete row.
unknownUpdateField.boundary: Stock observation, not permission for the adapter to ignore fields. The approved mapped-field validator must reject the whole unsupported mutation before sending any request.

ordering.duplicateKeys: The first sort key direction wins for both ascending-then-descending and descending-then-ascending requests on both backends.
ordering.callOrder: range-before-order and order-before-range selected the same descending priorities [6,5,4], matching the native bounded page.
ordering.unknownOrder: Native rejected with HTTP 500; reference returned error/no data.

explicitNonClaims: No FK/delete/trigger matrix, production validation, backend repair or G3/G4 gate signoff.
